children.value: The codec data states 8704 samples per block (17 frames) with the bit reservoir and variable block lengths, as the encoders of the Windows Media Format SDK and of Media Foundation write them

children.name: Evidence
children.value: ASF header layout of the Windows Media Format SDK's writer: WMFSDKVersion 9.00.00.4506, a Codec List Object and a Compatibility Object, which the files of Media Foundation's ASF sink lack. The writer states codec list "Windows Media Audio 9", " 16 kbps, 16 kHz, stereo 1-pass CBR"; IsVBR false (at 0x78F)

children.name: Evidence
children.value: Extended Content Description Object descriptor WMFSDKVersion at 0x78F names "Windows Media Format SDK 9.00.00.4506"

findings.message: The bytes after the last frame the superframes finish hold the frame they announce last, whole, in 5 bits, and then 5033 bits that no frame uses; the frame is counted in the samples.
2 frames that began in the superframe before are followed by zero bits up to the bit offset the superframe states, which a decoder skips; the first has 4938 (in the superframe at 0xC1D).
9 frames that began in the superframe before are followed by bits that are not zero up to the bit offset the superframe states, which a decoder skips; the first has 668 (in the superframe at 0x23B4).
